description: The only machine-readable view of Pakistani custody data — per-security CDS penetration and a twenty-year eligibility record, from a source no tool has ever automated.

novel_features.name: Coverage map + paginator integrity
novel_features.description: See exactly which document buckets are mirrored, which are genuinely absent at source, and which were never asked for.

novel_features.name: Identity ledger and point-in-time resolve
novel_features.description: Reconstruct a security's symbol, name and ISIN history so you never splice two different issuers into one return series.

novel_features.name: CDS eligibility state machine
novel_features.description: Get a security's full CDS-eligibility history folded from twenty years of notices into a six-state lifecycle.

novel_features.name: Row-level extraction audit
novel_features.description: Prove the PDF extraction is trustworthy by asserting the report's own percentage column against its own share and capital columns.

novel_features.name: Schema and seam gate
novel_features.description: Refuse to blend vintages whose column sets are incompatible, and refuse a month that is missing one of its parts.

novel_features.name: Three-way float reconciliation
novel_features.description: Put CDC custody penetration beside PSX free-float shares and NCCPL free-float percent, with each denominator named.

novel_features.name: Per-symbol Government of Pakistan stake
novel_features.description: Derive state-held capital per security from the difference between the including-GoP and excluding-GoP capital columns.

novel_features.name: Append-only statistics history
novel_features.description: Track the sixteen CDS aggregate metrics forward from your first sync, with archived rows labelled as such.
